deviations_from_s1.what: per-session timeout 120 s -> 1800 s (g2 and s1: 600 s)
deviations_from_s1.why: s1's 7 timeouts (g2: 23) were all still generating at 600 s; completed sessions took up to 478 s in s1 and 602 s in g2, and the larger grants below let sessions run up to 1.9x (discovery) and 2.5x (assessor) s1's tokens. Nothing upstream cuts a streamed request sooner: LiteLLM router timeout and litellm_settings.request_timeout are 3600 s (infrastructure c752f20, read live at freeze), the LAN WAF reverse proxy read/write timeouts are 3600 s, the vLLM serving role sets no request timeout, nare's 600 s httpx timeout applies per read on a stream (longest observed gap 62 s), and the evaluator has no timeout but this one. LAN path only (litellm.vividynamics.com), not Cloudflare
